The Manual#

The reference manual: character creation, the dungeon, combat, and the full command and option lists.

These chapters are inherited from Angband, which ZangbandTK is built on, and they describe the mechanics the two games share. Where a chapter here and a page under What’s Different disagree, the latter is correct — those pages are written for this game and these were adapted to it.

All seven have been checked against the game as it stands, and the statements that were Angband’s rather than this game’s have been corrected: the endgame, the map symbols, the keysets, the command and option lists, the file paths and the front ends. What has not been done is a rewrite — the prose, the examples and the emphasis are still Angband’s, and these chapters do not attempt to explain the wilderness, the towns, pets, mutations, patrons or the realms. Those have pages of their own.

Creating a Character is the furthest from its inherited form: it carries the full race and class tables for all twenty races and fourteen classes, and the racial powers, martial arts, psionics and patrons sections are this game’s own.
